# nah_load_balancer_backend (Resource)

Manages a NahCloud load_balancer_backend.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nah_load_balancer_backend" "app" {
  project          = nah_project.app.slug
  load_balancer_id = nah_load_balancer.app.id
  instance_id      = nah_instance.app.id
  port             = 8080
  weight           = 100
  enabled          = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) Opaque instance ID in the same subnet as the load balancer.
- `load_balancer_id` (String) Opaque parent load balancer ID.
- `port` (Number) Backend port.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the backend receives traffic.
- `weight` (Number) Routing weight, 1–100.

### Read-Only

- `healthy` (Boolean) True when enabled and the instance is running.
- `id` (String) Opaque stable resource ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import nah_load_balancer_backend.app my-app/LOAD_BALANCER_ID/BACKEND_ID
```
